process_principle: Build -> Review -> Test -> Fix specific failures. Use targeted refinement prompts and test-driven gates; avoid open-ended self-refinement.

items.title: Clear go-live evidence gates without bypassing safety
items.rationale: Clear every go-live gate with real evidence.
required_evidence: human signoff bound to current pack hash
items.safe_next_action: Resolve each named go-live gate with real artifacts; do not edit signoff until evidence exists.

items.title: Collect real forward paper evidence
items.rationale: Collect at least 50 resolved forward paper trades with fresh approved live-like quotes.
required_evidence: forward-paper JSONL files with paper-only fills and fresh moomoo decision quotes
items.safe_next_action: Run paper mode with live-like quotes until at least 50 resolved forward paper observations exist.

items.title: Fix failed operational health components
required_evidence: evidence={'risk_policy': {'ok': True, 'detail': '[]'}, 'kill_switch': {'ok': True, 'detail': 'clear'}, 'db_schema': {'ok': True, 'detail': '[]'}, 'mode': {'ok': True, 'detail': 'paper'}, 'live_data': {'ok': False, 'detail': 'moomoo OpenD is not reachable at 127.0.0.1:11111; reports/moomoo-live-quotes.json is missing; intraday quote age 1551s exceeds 900s freshness limit'}}
items.safe_next_action: Inspect failed health components and fix the underlying report, data, or service.

items.title: Restore moomoo real-time market-data health
items.rationale: Start OpenD, refresh moomoo quotes, and re-run live-data health.
items.safe_next_action: Start moomoo OpenD, refresh quotes, and verify reports/live-data-health.json is PASS.
